headline: Vermont jury convicts Jason Eaton in shooting of three Palestinian students
dek: Jurors found Eaton guilty of three counts of attempted second-degree murder in the 2023 Burlington shooting, rejecting his insanity defense. Sentencing has not been scheduled.
body: A Vermont jury on Monday found Jason Eaton guilty of three counts of attempted second-degree murder for shooting three Palestinian college students in Burlington in November 2023. The verdict followed a weeklong trial and rejected Eaton’s insanity defense, The Associated Press and Vermont Public reported.

The victims — Hisham Awartani, Kinnan Abdalhamid and Tahseen Aliahmad — were 20 at the time. All survived; Awartani was paralyzed from the waist down. Eaton, 51, did not dispute that he fired the shots, but his lawyers argued he was not criminally responsible because of a severe mental illness, according to the reports.

Prosecutors said the shooting occurred near the University of Vermont campus as the three friends walked together during Thanksgiving weekend. No hate-crime charges were filed, and the conviction does not itself establish a motive. The trial focused in part on Eaton’s mental state at the time of the attack.
Eaton was ordered held pending sentencing, which had not been scheduled in the initial reports. The verdict ends the criminal trial but leaves sentencing and any related proceedings ahead.
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: Vermont jury convicts Jason Eaton in Burlington shooting
